description: This file implements utility functions for RFC (Remote Function Call) management, including system event handling, RFC property reading via rbus or WDMP, executing system commands and capturing output, and parsing configuration files for cron scheduling. It appears to serve as a core component for managing RFC configurations and process synchronization in a device or system management context.

methods.name: std::string getSyseventValue(const std::string & key)
methods.description: Reads the value of a system event identified by 'key' by executing the 'sysevent get' command and returns the result as a string.

methods.name: void waitForRfcCompletion()
methods.description: Polls the system's RFC blob processing status via sysevent and waits until completion or timeout, with logging at each step.

methods.name: int read_RFCProperty(const char * type,const char * key,char * out_value,int datasize)
methods.description: Reads an RFC property identified by 'type' and 'key' into 'out_value', supporting both rbus and WDMP backends. Returns success or failure code.

methods.name: int executeCommandAndGetOutput(SYSCMD eSysCmd,const char * pArgs,std::string & result)
methods.description: Executes specified system commands (like RDKSsaCli or WpeFrameworkSecurityUtility) and captures their output into a string buffer.

methods.name: bool CheckSpecialCharacters(const std::string & str)
methods.description: Checks if a string contains any non-alphanumeric characters.

methods.name: bool StringCaseCompare(const std::string & str1,const std::string & str2)
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive comparison of two strings.

methods.name: void RemoveSubstring(std::string & str,const std::string & toRemove)
methods.description: Removes all occurrences of a substring from a string.

methods.name: std::string getCronFromDCMSettings()
methods.description: Reads cron schedule configuration from DCMSettings.conf or its temporary counterpart, validating and returning the cron expression.
